name: Adhesive Silicone Cell Phone/Credential Wallets
description: Now available with high-quality silkscreen imprinting, for sharper, brighter custom graphics! Versatile cell phone holder / credential wallet is made from silicone rubber with a 3M adhesive back. Up to three badges or cards sit firmly in the holder and will not fall out no matter how hard you shake it! Fits most flat-backed smart phones. Perfect for everyday use such as holding credit cards, hotel key, Metro card, ID badges or driver's license. Available in 4 stylish colors. Six imprint color options. Insert size: 2.25" x 3.38".
